card.head: Reports, built the way you ask for them.
card.sub: A tour of the report builder, on a made-up sample household.

scenes.say: In Groundwork 2.0, you can build your own reports. Everything here belongs to a made-up sample household.

scenes.focus: __both('Build a report', 'Start from one of the reports below')
scenes.say: It starts at the top of Reports, with Build a report.

scenes.do: _rcOpenReport('builder'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1800)); await _rbAskSend('monthly totals of debt payments from June to September');
scenes.say: Say what you want to see, in your own words. Groundwork puts the sections together, even with the AI turned off.
Each section is monthly totals, a trend, a list, a snapshot, a comparison or a what-if, over any period you name.
Every figure is worked out by Groundwork, from your own records. The AI never does the math.

scenes.do: const s = document.getElementById('rbStyle'); s.value = [...s.options].find(o => /grid/i.test(o.text)).value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
scenes.say: Pick one of six styles: text and grid, text and charts, charts first, text only, compact, or print-ready.

scenes.do: await _rbAskSend('spending by category in October compared with September');
scenes.say: A comparison lines up the two periods you name, line by line, with the change for each.
And when your records can't answer, the section says so plainly, instead of showing a number it can't stand behind.
Save a report, and next month it's ready again. Print it, or save it as a PDF.

card.head: Every figure from your own records.
card.sub: With the AI on or off · free for Windows, macOS and Linux

scenes.say: Every figure, from your own records. With the AI on or off. Groundwork 2.0 is free.
